title: Finite sum of binary digits
statement: Let $\rho<1$ be a real number and let $K$ be a natural number. The sum, for $0\le i<K$, of the $i$th binary digit of $\rho$ weighted by $2^{-(i+1)}$ equals $\lfloor 2^K\rho\rfloor/2^K$, where the digit is $1$ when the parity of the integer part of $2^{i+1}\rho$ is odd and is $0$ otherwise.
